newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mostly higher,below peaks.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mostly higher,below peaks.

text.p: April 15 - IMM currency futures crept up again late, ended mostly higher, off highs. Some said gain-cutting in U.S. stocks, lack of morning's downside followthrough, persuaded some day-shorts to bail out. Some also comments by Buba's Hesse that Buba has no choice but to insist on strict EMU criteria aided marks. Traders called daily volume moderate.
